description: This file contains implementations of various join operations (inner, right outer, left outer, full outer, and cogroup) for RDDs in PySpark, including helper functions and dispatch logic.

methods.name: _do_python_join
methods.description: Helper function to perform various join operations with a dispatch function.

methods.name: python_join
methods.description: Performs an inner join between two RDDs.

methods.name: python_right_outer_join
methods.description: Performs a right outer join between two RDDs.

methods.name: python_left_outer_join
methods.description: Performs a left outer join between two RDDs.

methods.name: python_full_outer_join
methods.description: Performs a full outer join between two RDDs.

methods.name: python_cogroup
methods.description: Performs a cogroup operation on multiple RDDs.
